name: The physics of skateboarding and of a physics sandbox, measured, so Farstone's board and sandbox laws rest on it
asks:
I want you putting more pressure on more of our systems at once to realize more of what we need at once, for example we've planned elsewhere trying to meet-then-beat Kerbal Space Program with our game engines, and then including in Farstone, our falgship MMORPG, a KSP-like game for folk (which is also part of how we justify our weird little MMORPG growing sci-fi wings)

---

There are lots of threads like that where the code or notes we got into uploaded on Github are muuuuch thinner than our actual conversation and plans, and thinner than the actual underlying codebase that could support them, and I want you to add that to your set of things that you're doing, making sure that all our ideas have become fuller in the repo resources than in our chat conversations.

(Farstone and KSP is just one example.)

---

I'm bringing it up for two things:

1) I also want Farstone to grow Tony Hawk Pro Skater (and similar game) capabiliies: think Goat Simulator and similar, but we do want specifically to add skateboarding and such.
2) We also already did some work on Farstone meet-then-beating Grand Theft Auto Online.

---

AND in a different direction I want to make sure that we are properly getting everything we can into an ASSIST program, that the ASSIST acronym, i.e. Agent-Supported Service Interface Simulation Topology?

the idea was to make ASSIST cleanly downstream of TUFTE (Tiling User Form Topology Engine), and then make a giant suite of ASSIST apps - we have some but want more: EVE Assist is one, Feng Shui Assist another, just a giant family of them.

Alpaca Assist is another, uh, Kalshi Assist, etc etc: any personal services section basically should get its own assist app, i.e. kalshi.assist.561.group, and then assist.561.group becomes the general dashboard, since they should all share types, work, governance, etc etc

board-opening.need: The physics section holds what is known of skateboard motion (rolling resistance of urethane wheels, ollie pop height, grind friction on steel and granite, the balance of a manual) and of the body and object motion a Goat Simulator-like sandbox needs (ragdoll, impacts, carried objects), with sources, so the engineering laws carry measured values instead of defaults.

requirements.says: The physics section shall hold a note on skateboard motion that states, with sources, the rolling resistance of skateboard wheels, the take-off speed and height of an ollie, the friction of a board sliding on a rail or ledge, and the balance of a rider on two wheels.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "specifically to add skateboarding and such"; Holofoam board (src/board.mjs, BOARD_LAWS) currently carries engineering defaults for each of these.

requirements.says: The physics section shall hold a note on the motion a physics sandbox game needs: articulated (ragdoll) bodies, impacts between bodies and objects carried or thrown.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "think Goat Simulator and similar".

requirements.says: Where a measured value differs from a Holofoam board law, the note shall name the law and the value it should take.
requirements.rationale: Science before engineering: the laws are corrected from the research, not the reverse.

conditions.says: A dated note on skateboard motion exists in the physics section.
A dated note on sandbox body and object motion exists in the physics section.
